Definition: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
BiblicalUsage: 1) eye; 1a) eye; 1a1) of physical eye; 1a2) as showing mental qualities; 1a3) of mental and spiritual faculties (fig.); 2) spring, fountain
